text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High 5xx rate observed for region az9 (apse1). Automatic page to oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-98321 triggered — Service: inference-runtime-az9 — Trigger: 5xx spike > 5% (1m)
megan (oncall): ACKed via PD. jumping in now. quick context pls — impact level?
raj (eng-runtime): seeing rapid connection resets from az9 frontends to shard-manager. kv-cache eviction churn around 23:45 UTC.
sylvia (support): monitoring customer error reports, ~23 customers showing elevated error rates on embeddings and generation endpoints. no SEC tickets yet.
alex (eng-sre): grabbing logs, running health checks.
megan (oncall): alex can you paste the healthcheck output? also pinging taylor for status page decision.
alex (eng-sre): health check summary:
```
# curl -sS http://az9-pool-ctrl/health
{"uptime":"9d","shards_healthy":4,"shards_total":6,"error_rate":"6.8%","kv_evictions_per_min":980}
```
alex (eng-sre): two model shards showing degraded GC loops and KV cache thrash, causing backpressure to routers.
raj (eng-runtime): looks like a kernel-level NIC flurry on the bottom-of-rack switches for az9-rt1, rt2. loss pattern matches pod restarts.
megan (oncall): pd escalations? any auto-escalate in flight?
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: PD escalation to MEGAN -> RAJ after 90s with no ack from senior. Additional notifications sent to eng-runtime and eng-sre.
raj (eng-runtime): I'm in. starting the failover playbook. first step: promote fallback routing to az7/az8 and disable new connections to az9.
megan (oncall): do it. paste the command so I can watch.
raj (eng-runtime): executing routing toggle:
```
# curl -X POST https://console.internal/v1/routing/fallback/activate -d '{"from_region":"az9","to_regions":["az7","az8"],"mode":"gradual"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN"
```
console-bot: routing change queued: gradual failover from az9 -> [az7, az8]. estimated time to divert traffic: 40s.
alex (eng-sre): starting instance drain on az9 hotspots to stop new work hitting degraded shards: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy shard-worker --replicas=2 --selector=zone=az9` :eyes:
sylvia (support): posting interim note to status page: "Degraded performance and errors in apse1 (az9). Engineers investigating; we may route traffic to adjacent zones." asking for approval.
taylor (product): approved. include ETA 30m for mitigation and note potential short-term latency increase during reroute.
megan (oncall): PD note: adding customer impact = "Partial failures for embeddings and generations in apse1 (az9). Some requests may return 5xx or higher latency. Customers may see intermittent errors until failover completes." sylvia can you publish?
sylvia (support): publishing now.
console-bot: status page updated (incident PD-98321): "Degraded performance in apse1, failover initiated" — link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-98321
raj (eng-runtime): failover ramping. traffic diverted ~65% after 90s, token throughput shifted to az7/az8. error rate falling to ~1.4% for routed traffic.
megan (oncall): monitoring error counts to customers. Alex, any signs of shard recovery or hardware flaps?
alex (eng-sre): NIC counters indicate CRC errors on nic0 for az9-rt2. ops opened a hardware ticket with provider — we can't rely on immediate replacement.
raj (eng-runtime): given hardware uncertainty, recommend sustain fallback for at least 2 hours and spin up extra capacity in az7 with quantized model variant to absorb peak.
megan (oncall): +1. initiate capacity spin and model variant switch.
raj (eng-runtime): commands:
```
# scale up az7 pool
consolectl pools scale --region az7 --pool inference-model --count +8
# enable quantized fallback variant for high-throughput routes
consolectl models variant enable --model rwinf-gpt-xxl-q4 --route /v1/generate --priority high
```
console-bot: capacity request accepted, provisioning nodes in az7. estimated ready in ~7m.
sylvia (support): customers with active errors being notified via support channels. internal CS playbook run id: cs-2026-06-03-az9-5xx
megan (oncall): PD-98321 update: oncall -> megan, raj, alex. next steps: keep failover active, monitor errors, update status every 15m. if errors <1% for 15m, start partial reopen of az9.
pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded. No further automatic escalations while PD-98321 is acknowledged by oncall.
raj (eng-runtime): will watch KV eviction rate and router queue depth. tagging in logs: `tag=PD-98321`.
alex (eng-sre): logs: `az9-rt2: kernel_nic_err=47, pod_restarts=13` — hardware vendor responded: provisioning swap scheduled (ETA 45m).
megan (oncall): thanks team. sylvia update status in 15. if any customer-impacting regression, ping PD and escalate to SEV.
sylvia (support): noted, updating channel when status page updated next.
megan (oncall): handoff: if this persists past 02:30 UTC, I'll hand to next oncall (raj covers shift handover). adding runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/az-failover
raj (eng-runtime): copying runbook steps and adding live notes in the runbook.
megan (oncall): closing loop for now — continuing watch. :white_check_mark:
